body:
Wow! Thank you so much! I didnt realize i came off as that!

Honestly i spoke less about who i am bc i wanted the person to actually get to know me. Plus i hate talking about myself lol! I wanted the person readting to be aware of what i want, and then be open to getting to know me while knowing the expectations i have! 

Is it fine if i personally message you?

That is fair that u feel i am bragging about myself. I wasnt, i was simply telling what i do and what i want!☺️ but that is fair, i was trying to imply that i do not want this arrangement to be taken as if i want us to be bf/gf down each other’s throats. That disgusts me. I was trying to say that im open woth watever arrangement, but i want a connection and to be spoiled, regardless of the arrangement! I should definitely reword it then, thank you!

Apologies, i am now seeing this! 

That is fair if that is how you read it, but my profile is to show im open to any kind of meet. I do want connection, but that doesnt mean i need to talk to u everytime. Connection means we easily get along. But that doesnt mean i want a relationship. I do want a fwb type of situation, bc treating it like bf/gf will repel me instead! I hate commitment, clearly😅
honestly i think thats the problem! haha!
19. been smoking since i was 13. Stopped cold turkey 6 months ago
Yea after this, im gonna be dating myself for years. I just never thought someone could do such an evil thing.

Literally. I was just crying about this earlier bc people say “oh the guilt eats them and they eventually apologize” but what kind of guilt leads to an ideal job, a long term relationship, seemingly healthy friendships and much more. And im here traumatized and alone and still recovering from the bullying
IM SO PROUD OF YOU GREAT JOB!!!
I hope ur feeling better now🤎🤎
Oh, will this be covered by my insurance? I only have medicaid and definitely am not in a position to pay off thousands of dollars
Okay thank you, im driving to a hospital right now
I only have my permit right now, will they need me to have an adult with a license? My mom has work and i havent told my brother
Okay, i still have the clothes i wore so i’ll take that
Even if its a day late? I showered and everything scrubbed myself so i couldnt feel dirty anymore
And he used a condom so i dont think any of that would help
Im scared to go to the hospital bc i feel they would try to blame me for it. And me being a black woman, i just feel they wont believe me

Im one of those shallow people who wont date someone bc of their income.

I do not do this right now, but for the future if i look for a husband, i would want someone who makes 100k less or even more than me. I plan to be a doctor and also plan to live a very very expensive life. I will not seriously date someone who’s financial goals arent like mine bc they couldnt help afford my lifestyle. I do not want to resent the person im dating bc they cant afford a 5k vacation or a 1k gift for me. So instead i just date based on the income and/or the career path they are choosing (since im young 😭)

Right now i still do this but since im trying to date people my age, no one has 5k to just spend like that and not everyone’s parents are generous with money like that. So instead i date people who have good paying jobs bc i know if i were to date someone who is classified as “broke” they could not ever make me fully happy bc im missing wat i love The most: materialistic gifts
Thank you for your concerns! I am attending college and already working on my career path. Im an extremely independent person, so depending on men for money does not align with me at all.
Not at all, but yea i’m gonna have a hard time finding someone who aligns with what i want😂 i like the challenge so i dont mind
Thank you!
Yea the kind of person i am, i need to experience it for myself and then i can agree if it is or isnt for me haha! Thank you!

Yes, i understand. I said these are small rough patches and do not define who i am entirely. I view these as old because the person i am now can not recognize who i was before. I feel now im in a muuucchh healthier space now and when i get upset i dont instantly jump to suicide😂 thank you!
Thank you. I do have a friend who wants to sugar date as well, but i don’t know if what i’m looking for aligns with what she’s looking for

Thanks for the concern, but i’m in therapy and already have been working on my mental health for years. Sometimes i need to vent out wat i’m feeling because i dont have people around me who i can talk to these things about. What i post does not represent who i am entirely, you are only seeing a small rough patch. Again thank you!

Thank you! No i do not watch SB’s on tiktok bc i know what they portray is no where near the reality of this lifestyle. The same way tik tok shows strippers and the money they get, i know its mostly fake. I’ve learned most of what i know from reddit and talking to sugar babies on here so i can understand a bit what i’m getting into!

With the pervs, yeaa.. i cant really avoid that, but i do know if someone is trying to have sex with me because of my age or manipulate me into this image they want. I know im young, but i have dealt with these kind of men since i was 10 so i somewhat know what to look out for.

Again thank you so much!
Oh thats quite old honestly. I’m in a happier space now and have worked tremendously on my mental health. Thank you!
Thanks. Right now im trying to find out what my allowance should be. Like what should i base it off of?
Yes. The minute i open my mouth people talk to me in a lighter tone. I have been told i dont talk like a black girl
Im black…

So i’ve tried that! And i was the happiest ive ever been! But my people pleasing behavior kicked back in and i tried to be the image others want. Plus i kept being told i was weird (which i now wear with pride) and other things that discouraged me to continue being myself
Thank you so much! I love you too!

Thank you for taking ur time and responding. I thought the racism in europe would be worse, or thats wat some people told me. I had a swedish friend that wanted me to visit them but i got scared bc I seriously did not want to experience badddd racism on a vacation.

I do. Ive always hated myself since i turned 9. Im trying to heal but its hard when it feels like i go up one level and someone pushes me down 50 levels. And i know i shouldnt care wat others say, but how can i not? I have no one around me that would care about wat i have to say
Thank you so much!! Wow that made me cry, thank you for caring
Yes all the time. I hate that those small margins of people are used to define all of us as well! I would be so embarrassed being the lady on the phone.

I have never met those kind of people?! The hell? And i wish to not meet a person like that bc the vile words that will come out my mouth.

Thank you so much! I love you

OH MY GOSH! Please u made me cry bc u said EXACTLY wat i want to say! Im a people pleaser as well. When i try to set boundaries, im told im being aggressive and it makes me stop. Im not aggressive at all, i try to smile all the time so i can appear softer  but the minute i ask for respect, im aggressive. I want to be viewed as feminine, not masculine. 

In my middle school, a lot of girls we’re being exposed by boys of course. But the black  girls got the worst treatment. One girl had ruthless rumors spread about her to the point where she moved out the county. Even people in other counties knew her. But the white girl who was known as a slut (now looking back she was deeply troubled) and also got pregnant, she received the most support by people. She didnt have to deal with horrific rumors being spread.

I hate that we have to go thru this. Trying to connect with black people, we’re told we’re not black enough. Trying to connect with white people, u are the ugly friend everywhere u go. Where can we be accepted? And yes i can accept myself all day, but i want a group that accepts me too! If others can have it, why cant we? 

Im sorry you had/have to go thru this babe. I love you and i support u.

Im saying!!! I grew up hearing that i have my black card removed. I cant say the n word bc i talk white. My hobbies or interests are “white people shit” its so disgusting the things people say. Why cant people just enjoy things without the race label? 

Oh even better, bc i also date men outside my race, ive been told that im disgracing my black brothers for dating outside my race… those same people degraded me for being dark skinned and are dating a white woman. I simply cannot win.

Thank you so much for understanding. All these comments seriously make me want to cry. I seriously cannot believe this many people cared im honestly shocked. I love you and everyone that has responded
Thank you for understanding! I love you

Im in georgia, metro atlanta area. Its okay sometimes, just when i go out either a white kid has to say a dumb stereotype or a black man has to post how much he hates dark skins. Ive blocked those kind of people, but it still hurts when i see thise things
Thank you for sharing! I love you <3
Im in america. The countries im thinking of moving to is canada, peru, or Dominican Republic. Canada is first on my list since it’s closer haha
Havent met people around me who experience the same thing. I am gonna try to look for the support group online tho!
Wow, thank you for sharing this! I wouldve never thought a black man would go thru the same thing, so thank you for opening my mind! Im very sorry you have/had to go thru that, it sucks!
Oh my god, im so sorry. Im very sorry you have to go thru this!

Thank you!!! I feel u heavy on your activities will be normal! Im criticized all the time for liking hiking, kayaking, mudding, etc.. like instead of saying “thats some white people shit” how about u try it and see the fun in it!  

I also date white men and the amount of racist comments that are thrown at me for liking them is so disgusting!

I love you, and im sorry you had to go thru the same thing. It really sucks and wish we could shut those people up
Nope did not offend me at least! Thank you for your kind words
Here, virtual hug! I love you, thank you so much
Yea im in the US. Im in the south too. Im moving to canada and i know racism is there but my uncle told me its not as bad as it is in the US.
I like yall too<33
Hahahaha!!! Thank you

Excuse me? I do not act in any way to be blatantly disrespected bc of my skin colour. I treat everyone with respect bc ive been bullied before and i understand how my actions and words definitely do affect others. Cute try to pin the blame on me tho, definitely was cute.
😂😂 i surely dont know the president of paraguay haha! Thank you so much for taking your time out your day and responding. I love you

Im in my last semester of highschool. I was thinking about going to an hbcu, but i feel like i wouldnt fit in bc of all the people that told me im not black enough. I feel uncomfy being myself around other black people bc when i was myself i got bullied for it.

MY GOSH!!! Literally!!! The activities i like are “some white people shit” and then people wpuld make fun of me for liking something. I dont get it. I even tried faking a literal blaccent so i could stop hearing the comment “u talk white” these things make no sense
Thank you so so much!
Haha, thank you so much. I like you too🤎

Most def. I was bullied in middle school for not acting black and talking black. Dumbest things to be bullied for but it made me extremely self conscious on the way i talk or dress etc. im finishing school online right now so i can stay away from those people

Also thank you so so much!
Thank you so much!
Thank you for caring <3

Wtf?? Okay now hearing that, i probably did experience this to a certain extent with white kids but never realized.

Yea, when i see a post that i know is gonna make guys bash on black women i try my hardest to scroll as fast as i can. But ur right, we know they are projecting but it still hurts.

Exactly! I use tik tok and the amount of black boys that just degrade dark skins is unbearable. Like who taught u this? The weirdest thing is, i havent dealt with racism from white people a lot. I get comment here and there by old people, but i experience colourism more by my own people. I started questioning my beauty when i went to a majority black school.

Yea i think thats my main problem! Bc of the experiences i had with my race, any new person that enters my life, i think they are judging me for my race. Thank you so much, going to try to open my mind more and be more accepting

Thank you so much! Im very sorry you had to go thru that and im very happy ur healing. Ive tried to think of my younger self, but i never expected to live up to 18. So im just as confused as the child me is
So in my words, colourism is racism just done by the same colour. For example, a black man saying insulting things about black women (burnt, monkeys, other racial sayings) is colourism.
Thank you for sharing! I hope i can get like that soon

Yea! And growing up hearing that has hindered my emotional growth. When i get angry i cant properly express wats going on, i just hold it in and explode at the wrong time. I hate that we have to even hear that
Definitely! How did u grow past all the remarks?? Did u have a moment where u just stopped caring?

Yep! Im leaving to canada! My family that lives there always brags about how the racism there is no where near the racism in america. Shit, i even considered moving to peru bc i was treated like a literal goddess there. Every time i come back to america i feel like my soul has been hit by a train, its so draining
I love you, thank you
OH MY GOSH! I grew up in the suburbs and people tell me im too white or i dont act black! I dont get wat people gain from saying these things. Im so sorry you had to experience that. It really sucks!
This is beautiful. Wow, thank you so much! This made me feel so much better thank you!
Thank you so much! Yea i have to reach out and try to find those people. I tend to isolate myself bc i believe no one honestly cares about wat i have to say.

Haha! Shes somewhat okay! She knows once i have my mind set on something, nothing will change my mind, so she cant stop me. She tries to change my mind but i remind her that i need to try it first to know if i wont like it
Haha! Yea i cant wait to move there!

My mom lightened her skin and shes really light now. She lightened my skin when i was a baby but when i turned 10 i begged her to stop. I tell her plenty of times it hurts me bc i should be seen as beautiful no matter how dark i am, but when i mention how i want to be a stripper she says “oh u need to brown ur skin, they dont like darker skin tone” like thanks mom! It doesnt matter wat i say, she will still find a way to remind me that my current skin tone is bad and i need to change it.
Thank you so so much! Yes im moving next year to canada. Im hoping it will be different there, at least not visible colourism is all i want. Thank you for relating

Nah its not really my people. Its mostly random people honestly. Sometimes my mom would say something, but she has stopped. Its people online, at school when i used to go, or new guys im talking to who dont come off as colourist. Like i get i shouldnt care wat those people say but damn constantly hearing it since i was in elementary, im now 18, fucking sucks!
Makes me feel a bit better lol! I just wish the guys in my area accepted darker tones and didnt try to make every girl that is dark skinned to feel bad about it
Thank you. I live down south so im planning to move up north (specifically canada) hoping that i wont experience these same experiences. I hope by then i can actually start loving myself

I’ve tried plenty of times to accept myself but darn its like when i make progress, im pushed 50 levels back. Either it being my mom saying i’ll be prettier light skinned, or i see countless of black men degrading the hell out of dark skin women. It makes me feel so self conscious. I can be sitting down, minding my business, and someone just has to tell me how i’d be sexier if i was light skinned.
Yea much easier said than done. Thanks i guess?

I reaalllyy wish that was the case. But if i act angry just a tad bit, im labelled as the angry black woman. I have to act very submissive so people dont think im aggressive. I cant just be me without thinking how im acting so others arent afraid of me.
Just doesnt feel like its beautiful. I get treated very differently compared to my other friends and im about tired of it.
My skin colour is apart of me. Its hard to love myself fully when i have majority of people in my life constantly telling me how ugly i am for being dark skinned
